readme:
# BKJ Group (Batam Kepri Jaya)

**Live Website:** [bkjgrup.com](https://bkjgrup.com)

A comprehensive corporate web portal and Content Management System (CMS) built for Batam Kepri Jaya (BKJ Group). This platform provides a centralized, dynamic, and localized web presence for the company and its various subsidiaries, allowing administrators to manage content, news, services, and client portfolios effortlessly.

## Motivation and Architecture (The "Why")

The BKJ Group required a robust and scalable digital platform to consolidate its corporate identity and manage multiple subsidiary profiles under a single, unified system. The architectural goal was to build a secure, high-performance web application that delivers a premium user experience on the frontend while providing a flexible, structured CMS on the backend.

We chose the Laravel ecosystem for its powerful MVC architecture, built-in security features, and excellent developer experience. On the frontend, the integration of Tailwind CSS v4, Alpine.js, and GSAP ensures a highly responsive, modern, and animated interface without the overhead of heavy SPA frameworks. The application also implements dynamic asset handling (like subsidiary-specific favicons) and content localization to cater to a diverse audience.

## Tech Stack

**Backend**
- PHP 8.3
- Laravel 13 (MVC Framework)
- MySQL (Relational Database)

**Frontend**
- Tailwind CSS v4 (Utility-first styling)
- Alpine.js (Lightweight JavaScript behavior)
- GSAP & Lenis (Advanced animations and smooth scrolling)
- Splide (Accessible sliders)
- Vite (Next-generation frontend tooling)

**Key Packages & Integrations**
- Laravel Breeze (Authentication scaffolding)
- Spatie Media Library (File and image management)
- Spatie Sitemap (Automated SEO sitemap generation)
- Stichoza Google Translate PHP (Dynamic localization)

## Features

- **Dynamic Content Management:** Full admin control over core pages including Home, About, Gallery, Contact, and Offices.
- **Subsidiary Management:** Dedicated profiles, assets (icons/favicons), and content routing for individual BKJ Group subsidiaries.
- **News & Blog Center:** Integrated publishing platform for corporate announcements and industry news.
- **Localization:** Multi-language support (English and Indonesian) to serve both local and international stakeholders.
- **Role-Based Access Control:** Secure admin dashboard with Super Admin privileges for comprehensive user and role management.
- **Performance Optimized:** Leveraging Vite for asset bundling, caching strategies, and responsive image handling via Spatie Media Library.
- **SEO & Accessibility:** Automated sitemaps, semantic HTML, and optimized metadata for search engine visibility.

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

Ensure your local development environment meets the following requirements:
- **PHP:** `^8.3`
- **Composer:** Latest stable version
- **Node.js & npm:** (v18+ recommended)
- **Database:** MySQL or MariaDB

### Installation

1. **Clone the repository**
   ```bash
   git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/bkj.git
   cd bkj
   ```

2. **Run setup script**
   ```bash
   composer setup
   ```

3. **Start development server**
   ```bash
   composer dev
   ```

## Author & Contact

- **Author:** Muhammad Aga Putra & The BKJ Group Team
- **Email:** agaputra62@gmail.com | admin@bkjgroup.com
- **Website:** [bkjgrup.com](https://bkjgrup.com)

# 💖 CINTA — School Counseling & Anonymous Reporting Platform
[![Laravel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Laravel-10.x-FF2D20?style=for-the-badge&logo=laravel&logoColor=white)](https://laravel.com) [![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind-3.x-38B2AC?style=for-the-badge&logo=tailwind-css&logoColor=white)](https://tailwindcss.com) [![Vite](https://img.shields.io/badge/Vite-Bundler-646CFF?style=for-the-badge&logo=vite&logoColor=white)](https://vitejs.dev) [![Security](https://img.shields.io/badge/Privacy-End--to--End-emerald?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Apisikma123)
**CINTA (Care, Integrity, & Nurturing Trust Association)** is a specialized school counseling and anonymous incident reporting web system designed to bridge the communication gap between students and guidance counselors (Guru BK).
--- ## 🌟 Problem & Motivation ("The Why") Many students facing bullying, academic distress, or personal challenges hesitate to seek counseling due to fear of stigma, breach of privacy, or peer judgment. Traditional reporting methods (physical suggestion boxes or face-to-face reports) lack confidentiality and tracking capabilities. **CINTA** was engineered to provide: 1. **A safe, encrypted, and anonymous reporting channel** where students can share issues without fear. 2. **A structured case management dashboard** for counselors to triage, document counseling sessions, schedule appointments, and maintain student welfare records safely. --- ## 🛠️ Key Features - **🔒 Anonymous & Authenticated Reporting Modes**: Students can submit reports with full anonymity or choose to link their student identity for direct follow-up. - **📅 Counseling Appointment Scheduler**: Interactive booking system where students can request private counseling time slots based on counselor availability. - **📊 Counselor Case Management Pipeline**: KanBan-style workflow for managing case status (*New ➔ In Review ➔ Session Scheduled ➔ Resolved ➔ Follow-up Required*). - **🔐 Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)**: Strict segregation between Student, Teacher/Counselor, and School Administrator roles. - **📑 Confidential PDF Case Summaries**: Automated generation of case recap documents with sensitive identifier masking. --- ## 🏗️ Tech Stack | Layer | Technology | Usage | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **Backend** | PHP 8.2 + Laravel 10 | Robust MVC architecture, Eloquent ORM, and secure authentication | | **Frontend** | Blade + Tailwind CSS + Alpine.js | Modern responsive UI with clean interactive micro-interactions | | **Database** | MySQL | Relational schema with foreign key cascading and encrypted report bodies | | **Build Tool** | Vite | Ultra-fast asset compilation and CSS hot-module replacement | --- ## 🚀 Installation & Local Setup ```bash # 1. Clone the repository git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/cinta--website-konseling-sekola-.git cd cinta--website-konseling-sekola- # 2. Install dependencies composer install npm install # 3. Environment configuration cp .env.example .env php artisan key:generate # 4. Database migration & seeders php artisan migrate --seed # 5. Run development servers php artisan serve npm run dev ``` --- ## 👨‍💻 Author & Contribution - **Developer:** Muhammad Aga Putra ([@Apisikma123](https://github.com/Apisikma123)) - **License:** Open-source under the MIT License.

readme:
# 🍕 FOODIFY — Food Delivery Mobile App (Medan City)
[![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-3.x-02569B?style=for-the-badge&logo=flutter&logoColor=white)](https://flutter.dev) [![Dart](https://img.shields.io/badge/Dart-3.x-0175C2?style=for-the-badge&logo=dart&logoColor=white)](https://dart.dev) [![State Management](https://img.shields.io/badge/Provider-6.1.2-orange?style=for-the-badge)](https://pub.dev/packages/provider) [![Map](https://img.shields.io/badge/OpenStreetMap-flutter__map-green?style=for-the-badge&logo=openstreetmap&logoColor=white)](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_map)
**FOODIFY** is a modern, responsive, and feature-rich food delivery mobile application built with Flutter. Specifically tailored for exploring and ordering food across **Medan City (Kota Medan), Indonesia**, it combines smooth Material 3 UI design, real-time map integration, state management with Provider, and simulated live driver delivery tracking.
--- ## 🌟 Key Features ### 📍 1. Smart Geolocation & Interactive Map - **GPS Auto-Detection**: Automatically fetches user location using the `geolocator` plugin. - **Interactive OpenStreetMap**: Visualizes nearby Medan restaurants with interactive map markers using `flutter_map` and `latlong2`. - **Custom Location Picker**: Allows customers to manually drag and drop pins on the map to pinpoint exact delivery addresses. - **Distance-Based Delivery Calculation**: Accurately computes delivery distance (km) and dynamically calculates delivery fees. ### 🍽️ 2. Restaurant Discovery & Menus - **Category Filtering**: Browse through popular food categories including *Ayam (Chicken)*, *Nasi (Rice dishes)*, *Mie (Noodles)*, *Pizza*, *Snacks*, and *Beverages (Minuman)*. - **Search Functionality**: Instant keyword search for restaurants and specific food dishes. - **Dynamic Promo Carousel**: Eye-catching promotional banners with automatic scrolling and smooth page indicators. - **Detailed Restaurant Profiles**: View operating hours, live ratings, delivery estimates, distance, and categorized menus. ### 🛒 3. Cart & Order Customization - **Food Modifiers & Notes**: Customize orders with portion controls and specific preparation notes. - **Smart Cart Validation**: Single-restaurant checkout validation to avoid mixed multi-restaurant delivery conflicts. - **Real-Time Total Recalculation**: Subtotal, delivery fee, and service charges calculated automatically. ### 🛵 4. Live Order Tracking & Simulation - **Multi-Stage Order Pipeline**: Real-time status progression (*Order Received ➔ Cooking ➔ Driver Picking Up ➔ On the Way ➔ Delivered*). - **Animated Driver Route**: Live interactive map display illustrating driver movement toward the destination. - **Driver Info Bottom Sheet**: Simulated direct driver phone call and messaging interface. --- ## 🏗️ Tech Stack & Architecture | Technology / Package | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | | **[Flutter](https://flutter.dev)** | Cross-platform UI toolkit | | **[Dart](https://dart.dev)** | Application programming language | | **[Provider](https://pub.dev/packages/provider)** | State management pattern for Cart, Location, Orders, and Auth | | **[flutter_map](https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_map)** & **[latlong2](https://pub.dev/packages/latlong2)** | OpenStreetMap rendering, markers, and coordinate geometry | | **[geolocator](https://pub.dev/packages/geolocator)** | Device GPS location handling and permissions | | **[shared_preferences](https://pub.dev/packages/shared_preferences)** | Local key-value storage for user sessions and orders | --- ## 🚀 Getting Started ```bash # 1. Clone repository git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/foodify.git cd foodify # 2. Get Flutter dependencies flutter pub get # 3. Run application flutter run -d chrome ``` ## 📄 License This project is open-source under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

readme:
# 🌿 Grow a Garden — Urban Farming & Hydroponics Management Platform
[![Laravel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Laravel-10.x-FF2D20?style=for-the-badge&logo=laravel&logoColor=white)](https://laravel.com) [![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind_CSS-3.x-38B2AC?style=for-the-badge&logo=tailwind-css&logoColor=white)](https://tailwindcss.com) [![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-8.0-4479A1?style=for-the-badge&logo=mysql&logoColor=white)](https://mysql.com) [![Category](https://img.shields.io/badge/Domain-Urban_AgriTech-green?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Apisikma123)
**Grow a Garden** is an interactive web platform designed for urban farmers, hydroponic hobbyists, and community gardens to monitor plant life cycles, nutrient solutions (PPM/pH), watering schedules, and harvest timelines.
--- ## 🌟 Motivation & Architecture Urban farming in limited city spaces requires precision monitoring of growth cycles, sunlight exposure, and nutrient replenishment. Beginners often struggle with tracking planting dates, harvest readiness, and soil moisture levels. **Grow a Garden** solves this by providing: 1. **Digital Plant Inventory & Spatial Bed Mapping**: Track crops per bed or hydroponic tower with visual progress meters. 2. **Automated Care Schedules**: Algorithmic calculation of fertilization, pruning, and harvesting target dates based on plant species. 3. **Harvest Logs & Productivity Analytics**: Track yield weights and cycle durations to optimize future crop rotations. --- ## 🛠️ Core Features - **🌱 Plant Lifecycle Tracker**: Record plant batches from seed germination ➔ vegetative state ➔ flowering ➔ harvesting. - **💧 Hydroponic Nutrient & pH Logger**: Monitor water reservoir EC/PPM and pH levels with visual warning indicators for threshold violations. - **📅 Smart Garden Calendar**: Daily checklist of tasks (watering, adding nutrients, pest inspection, harvesting). - **📈 Growth & Yield Reports**: Data visualization of harvest output across different seasons and crop varieties. --- ## 💻 Tech Stack - **Backend**: Laravel 10.x, PHP 8.2, Eloquent ORM, RESTful Controllers - **Frontend**: Blade Templating, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, Chart.js - **Database**: MySQL 8.0 with relational crop & batch tables - **Build System**: Vite --- ## 🚀 Getting Started ```bash # 1. Clone repo git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/Grow-a-garden.git cd Grow-a-garden # 2. Dependencies & environment composer install npm install cp .env.example .env php artisan key:generate # 3. Database & serve php artisan migrate --seed php artisan serve ``` ## 📄 License Open source under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

descriptionEn: Centralized library donation platform built with TALL stack, Google OAuth 2.0, automated PDF reporting, and real-time WebSockets via Laravel Reverb.
readme:
# 📚 Wilmar Buku — Library Book Donation & Cataloging Platform

**Wilmar Buku** is a comprehensive web-based platform dedicated to managing institutional and community library donations. The application streamlines the contribution workflow, providing a centralized administrative dashboard, automated donor certification, and real-time WebSocket status updates.

## Motivation & Architecture

Traditional donation management suffers from fragmented manual ledgers, unverified book logs, and slow administrative processing. Wilmar Buku was architected on the **TALL Stack (Tailwind, Alpine.js, Laravel, Livewire/Reverb)** to ensure ultra-fast reactivity without the complexity of heavy single-page apps.

Real-time WebSocket event broadcasting powered by **Laravel Reverb** ensures instantaneous synchronization of donation approvals across administrative and contributor screens.

## Tech Stack

- **Backend:** PHP 8.3, Laravel 13.x, MySQL, Laravel Reverb (WebSockets)
- **Frontend:** Blade, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, Chart.js
- **Security & Auth:** Google OAuth 2.0 via Laravel Socialite, Role-Based Access Control
- **Reporting:** DomPDF for automated donor appreciation certificates and inventory audits

## Key Features

- **Google OAuth 2.0 Single Sign-On:** Frictionless donor onboarding.
- **Real-Time Notification Broadcasting:** Instant UI updates upon donation approval.
- **Automated Certificate Generation:** Instant downloadable PDF appreciation certificates.
- **Analytics Dashboard:** Visual trends on donated book genres, monthly volume, and community contributors.

## Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/wilmarbuku.git
cd wilmarbuku
composer install && npm install
cp .env.example .env && php artisan key:generate
php artisan migrate --seed
npm start
```

## License
Licensed under the [MIT License](LICENSE).

readme:
# 🏢 HR Presence - Smart Attendance & HR Management System

Sistem Manajemen Kehadiran & SDM Modern berbasis Web & Mobile dengan fitur **AI Face Recognition (Pengenalan Wajah)**, **GPS Geofencing Radius Lokasi**, **Manajemen Shift Kerja**, **Pengajuan Izin/Sakit/Cuti**, serta **Laporan Otomatis**.

---

## 🌟 Fitur Utama (Key Features)

- 📸 **AI Face Recognition**: Deteksi dan verifikasi sidik wajah otomatis menggunakan *Face-API.js (TinyFaceDetector)* dengan validasi posisi tengah lingkaran & anti-kecurangan (*strict threshold*).
- 📍 **GPS Geofencing Multi-Cabang**: Presensi berbasis koordinat GPS dan radius presisi menggunakan *Leaflet JS* & *OpenStreetMap*.
- 👥 **Manajemen Organisasi & Karyawan**: Pengelolaan data Master Karyawan, Departemen, Jabatan, dan Multi-Cabang kantor.
- ⏰ **Jadwal & Shift Jam Kerja**: Konfigurasi jam kerja harian, mingguan, per departemen, hingga jadwal fleksibel/lintas hari.
- 📑 **Pengajuan Izin, Cuti & Sakit**: Alur persetujuan (*Approval Workflow*) dari pengajuan karyawan hingga approval HRD/Manager.
- 📊 **Laporan & Rekap Otomatis**: Rekap presensi harian, bulanan, statistik kehadiran, dan ekspor instan ke format **PDF** & **Excel**.
- 📱 **PWA & Mobile UI**: Tampilan antarmuka mobile responsif dengan *Bottom Navigation Bar* khas aplikasi smartphone.
- ⚡ **REST API Mobile Ready**: Backend controller API lengkap di `/api/mobile/` yang siap diintegrasikan dengan aplikasi Android/iOS Native (Flutter / React Native).

---

## 🛠️ Kebutuhan Sistem (Prerequisites)

1. **PHP**: Versi `8.1` atau `8.2` atau `8.3`
2. **Composer**: Versi `2.x`
3. **Database**: MySQL `5.7+` atau MariaDB
4. **Web Browser**: Chrome / Safari modern dengan izin akses **Kamera & Lokasi (GPS)**.

---

## 🚀 Panduan Instalasi

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/presensi-gps.git
cd presensi-gps
composer install
cp .env.example .env
php artisan key:generate
php artisan storage:link
php artisan migrate:fresh --seed
php artisan serve
```

## 📄 Lisensi
Sistem ini dikembangkan untuk kebutuhan internal manajemen SDM dan presensi karyawan.

# 📦 Sistem Inventaris Sarana & Aset Perusahaan (Wilmar)
[![Laravel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Laravel-Enterprise-FF2D20?style=for-the-badge&logo=laravel&logoColor=white)](https://laravel.com) [![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-Database-4479A1?style=for-the-badge&logo=mysql&logoColor=white)](https://mysql.com) [![Asset Tracking](https://img.shields.io/badge/Audit-Asset_Management-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Apisikma123)
**Sistem Inventaris Sarana Wilmar** adalah aplikasi manajemen aset fisik, peralatan kantor, dan prasarana operasional terpadu yang dirancang untuk memastikan transparansi stok, riwayat peminjaman, jadwal pemeliharaan, dan audit aset berkala.
--- ## 🌟 Problem & Architecture Pengelolaan aset perusahaan skala besar sering menghadapi masalah kehilangan barang, duplikasi pencatatan, dan ketidakjelasan penanggung jawab peralatan. Sistem ini mengimplementasikan: - **Unique Asset Tagging (Kode Unik & QR Generator)** untuk identifikasi cepat setiap unit aset. - **Audit Trail & Custody History**: Mencatat perpindahan unit dari gudang ke divisi tertentu secara akurat. - **Kondisi Aset Real-time**: Klasifikasi status (*Baik, Perlu Perbaikan, Rusak Total, Dihapus dari Buku*). --- ## 🛠️ Fitur Utama - **📋 Master Data Sarana**: Pencatatan merk, serial number, tanggal pengadaan, nilai perolehan, dan lokasi penempatan. - **🔄 Alur Peminjaman & Pengembalian**: Formulir digital checkout peminjaman dengan persetujuan kepala divisi. - **🛠️ Jadwal Maintenance & Servis**: Notifikasi berkala untuk servis mesin dan kalibrasi alat. - **📊 Laporan Mutasi & Stock Opname**: Ekspor laporan aset bulanan dalam format Excel dan PDF siap cetak. --- ## 💻 Teknologi yang Digunakan - **Framework**: Laravel MVC (PHP 8.2+) - **Database**: MySQL dengan relasi data terindeks (InnoDB) - **Frontend**: Bootstrap 5 / Tailwind CSS + DataTables.js - **Export**: Maatwebsite Excel & DomPDF --- ## 🚀 Instalasi Lokal ```bash git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/inventaris-wilmar.git cd inventaris-wilmar composer install cp .env.example .env php artisan key:generate php artisan migrate --seed php artisan serve ``` ## 👨‍💻 Author & License - **Author:** Muhammad Aga Putra ([@Apisikma123](https://github.com/Apisikma123)) - **License:** MIT License

readme:
# ⚡ My WO Planner — Work Order & Field Dispatch PWA
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-5.x-3178C6?style=for-the-badge&logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](https://typescriptlang.org) [![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-18.x-61DAFB?style=for-the-badge&logo=react&logoColor=black)](https://react.dev) [![PWA](https://img.shields.io/badge/PWA-Offline_First-5A0FC8?style=for-the-badge&logo=pwa&logoColor=white)](https://web.dev/progressive-web-apps/) [![Capacitor](https://img.shields.io/badge/Capacitor-Cross_Platform-119EFF?style=for-the-badge&logo=capacitor&logoColor=white)](https://capacitorjs.com)
**My WO Planner** is an offline-first Progressive Web Application (PWA) and mobile tool engineered for field technicians, operations dispatchers, and project managers to plan, schedule, and execute Work Orders (WO) efficiently without internet dependency.
--- ## 🌟 Why My WO Planner? Field technicians often operate in basements, industrial sites, or remote locations with poor network connectivity. Traditional web applications fail when offline, resulting in lost checklists and delayed task updates. **My WO Planner** implements **IndexedDB local persistence** and background service workers to ensure 100% functionality offline, automatically synchronizing data when connectivity is restored. --- ## 🛠️ Core Features - **📅 Interactive Timeline & Gantt View**: Drag-and-drop task assignment across team members and time slots. - **📱 Offline-First Architecture**: Create, update, and complete work orders with photo attachments even with zero cellular connection. - **✅ Interactive Inspection Checklists**: Step-by-step verification checklists with digital signature capture. - **⚡ High-Performance React + Vite Core**: Instantaneous page transitions with zero latency. --- ## 🏗️ Architecture & Stack - **Language**: TypeScript (100% strict type safety) - **Framework**: React 18 + Vite Bundler - **Styling**: Tailwind CSS + Headless UI - **Storage**: IndexedDB (via Dexie.js) + LocalStorage - **Mobile Hybrid**: Capacitor JS for native Android & iOS builds --- ## 🚀 Running Locally ```bash git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/my-wo-planner.git cd my-wo-planner npm install npm run dev ``` ## 📄 License MIT License — Open-source software by [Muhammad Aga Putra](https://github.com/Apisikma123).

readme:
# 🚆 Kereta Tapir — Train Ticketing & Transit Route Simulator
[![Laravel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Laravel-PHP_8-FF2D20?style=for-the-badge&logo=laravel&logoColor=white)](https://laravel.com) [![Algorithms](https://img.shields.io/badge/Algorithm-Shortest_Path-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Apisikma123) [![MySQL](https://img.shields.io/badge/MySQL-Database-4479A1?style=for-the-badge&logo=mysql&logoColor=white)](https://mysql.com)
**Kereta Tapir** is an interactive railway transit routing, seat allocation, and booking simulator designed to model complex multi-station railway networks and ticket fare calculations.
--- ## 🌟 Features & Capabilities - **🗺️ Transit Network & Route Finder**: Computes transit paths between origin and destination stations, calculating travel durations, transit layovers, and distance. - **💺 Interactive Train Carriage Seat Map**: Visual coach layout (Executive, Business, Economy) with real-time seat availability selection. - **🎫 Digital Boarding Pass & QR Generator**: Programmatic booking code generator with verifiable digital pass. - **📊 Train Scheduling & Station Master Dashboard**: Administrative control over train fleets, station timetables, and delay logs. --- ## 🛠️ Stack & Installation - **Backend**: Laravel 10.x, PHP 8.2 - **Frontend**: Blade, Tailwind CSS, JavaScript - **Database**: MySQL relational railway schema ```bash git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/kereta-tapir.git cd kereta-tapir composer install && npm install cp .env.example .env && php artisan key:generate php artisan migrate --seed php artisan serve ``` ## 📄 License MIT License — Developed by Muhammad Aga Putra.

# 🏫 Sistem Informasi Bimbingan & Konseling Sekolah (Web Laporan BK)
[![Laravel](https://img.shields.io/badge/Laravel-10.x-FF2D20?style=for-the-badge&logo=laravel&logoColor=white)](https://laravel.com) [![Tailwind CSS](https://img.shields.io/badge/Tailwind-UI-38B2AC?style=for-the-badge&logo=tailwind-css&logoColor=white)](https://tailwindcss.com) [![Education](https://img.shields.io/badge/Domain-Education_System-indigo?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Apisikma123)
**Web Laporan BK** adalah sistem informasi komprehensif bagi guru Bimbingan Konseling (BK) dan pimpinan sekolah untuk mengelola catatan bimbingan, rekap poin kedisiplinan & prestasi, serta penerbitan laporan konseling siswa.

readme:
# ☕ Belajar Java — OOP, Data Structures & Algorithm Suite
[![Java](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17%20%2F%2021-ED8B00?style=for-the-badge&logo=openjdk&logoColor=white)](https://oracle.com/java/) [![Data Structures](https://img.shields.io/badge/Algorithms-Data_Structures-blue?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Apisikma123) [![OOP](https://img.shields.io/badge/OOP-Design_Patterns-green?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/Apisikma123)
Comprehensive repository containing foundational to advanced Java implementations, including Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) paradigms, classic computer science data structures, and algorithmic problem-solving examples.
--- ## 📚 Contents & Architecture ### 1. Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) - **Encapsulation & Access Modifiers**: Data hiding, getter/setter patterns, and record classes. - **Inheritance & Polymorphism**: Abstract classes, interfaces, method overriding, and dynamic dispatch. - **Design Patterns**: Singleton, Factory Pattern, Builder Pattern, Observer, and Strategy Pattern. ### 2. Custom Data Structures - **Linear**: Custom Singly/Doubly Linked Lists, Array-based Stacks, Circular Queues, Priority Queues. - **Non-Linear**: Binary Search Trees (BST), AVL Tree rebalancing, Trie for prefix lookups, Graph adjacency lists. ### 3. Classic Algorithms & Big-O Analysis - **Sorting**: QuickSort, MergeSort, HeapSort, BubbleSort. - **Searching**: Binary Search, Breadth-First Search (BFS), Depth-First Search (DFS), Dijkstra's shortest path. --- ## 🚀 Running Examples ```bash git clone https://github.com/Apisikma123/belajar-java.git cd belajar-java javac src/Main.java -d bin java -cp bin Main ``` ## 📄 License MIT License © Muhammad Aga Putra.
